# Part B: Marble Probability

Total marbles = 13, choose 3: C(13,3) = 286

"At least two share a color" is complement of "all three different colors" (only possible as one red, one green, one blue since there are only 3 colors):

Ways for one of each color = 5×3×5 = 75

P(all different) = 75/286
P(at least two same color) = 1 − 75/286 = 211/286

Since 211 is prime and doesn't divide 286 (=2×11×13), the fraction is already in lowest terms.

**Result: 211/286**
